requirements.title: Front-end gain
requirements.description: The receiver front end shall provide 20 dB gain at 146 MHz.

requirements.title: Orphan parent
requirements.description: The receiver shall reject images by 60 dB.
requirements.rationale: Parent does not exist on purpose; TS-001 is cited while docs/decisions/trade-studies/ is absent (SOURCE_FILE_MISSING).

requirements.title: No parent and not self-derived
requirements.description: The receiver shall mute audio within 10 ms of key down.
requirements.rationale: Wanted by the author; no parent and no derivation statement are seeded on purpose (T-05, PARENT_MISSING).

requirements.title: Self-derived without a decision record
requirements.description: The receiver shall recover from a synthesizer unlock within 50 ms.
requirements.rationale: Self-derived: no ADR or trade study records this and no hazard is cited; seeded for T-05 (SELF_DERIVED_UNSUPPORTED).

requirements.title: Tags without their obligations
requirements.description: The receiver shall limit headphone output to 100 mW into 32 ohm.
requirements.rationale: Tags safety, regulatory and interface without hazard_ids, a 47CFR97 clause or an ICD id are seeded on purpose (02 section 2.3).

requirements.title: Active child of a Draft parent
requirements.description: The receiver shall present an input return loss of 10 dB or better across the band.
requirements.rationale: Active while the parent REQ-SYS-006 is Draft; seeded for T-11 (CHILD_AHEAD_OF_PARENT).
